## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run python scripts/check.py` is green (or, if you do not have
      frob installed, the test suite is green: `uv run pytest -q`)
- [ ] Tests added and bound with `# frob:tests` where applicable
- [ ] Docs updated in `docs/*.md`, with the `# frob:doc` anchor kept in
      sync where applicable
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under the "unreleased" section
- [ ] Commit messages follow the `<type>(<scope>): <imperative summary>`
      format described in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] ASCII only (no emojis, no smart quotes, no em dashes)
- [ ] AI assistance: none / <tool>, <how used> (drafted / reviewed / tests written)
- [ ] I understand and can explain every line of this change
